in_sanskrit.name: Nitul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nitul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nitul is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Nit’ which means ‘to bestow’ and ‘Ul’ meaning ‘mind’. This name signifies the one who bestows wisdom and knowledge. It is a name for a boy who is intelligent, wise and has a calm mind.
